# Code of Conduct / 行為準則

## Our standard / 我們的標準

Lumix is committed to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free community. Be constructive, assume good intent while addressing impact, and keep technical disagreement focused on ideas and evidence.

Lumix 致力於建立友善、尊重且不受騷擾的社群。請保持建設性；可先假設善意，但也應正視行為造成的影響，並讓技術歧見聚焦於想法與證據。

Acceptable behavior includes:

- Giving specific, actionable feedback
- Respecting different experience levels and viewpoints
- Correcting mistakes openly and graciously
- Protecting other people's privacy and safety

可接受的行為包括：

- 提供具體且能採取行動的意見
- 尊重不同經驗程度與觀點
- 坦然且友善地修正錯誤
- 保護他人的隱私與安全

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized attention, doxxing, deliberate disruption, or sustained personal attacks.

不可接受的行為包括騷擾、歧視、威脅、性意味關注、人肉搜尋、蓄意干擾或持續的人身攻擊。

## Scope and enforcement / 適用範圍與執行

This policy applies to repository discussions, issues, pull requests, reviews, and other spaces where someone represents Lumix. Maintainers may edit or remove content, lock conversations, reject contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary.

本政策適用於 repo 討論、Issue、Pull Request、Review，以及代表 Lumix 的其他空間。必要時，維護者可編輯或移除內容、鎖定討論、拒絕貢獻，或暫時／永久限制參與。

For urgent threats, use GitHub's own report and blocking tools. For a confidential project-specific report, use the [private report form](https://github.com/0png/Lumix/security/advisories/new) and prefix the title with `[Conduct]`. Do not include more personal data than necessary. Reports are reviewed as privately as practical, and retaliation against a good-faith reporter is not tolerated.

若有立即威脅，請使用 GitHub 的檢舉與封鎖工具。若需私下回報本專案相關事件，請使用[私人通報表單](https://github.com/0png/Lumix/security/advisories/new)，並在標題加上 `[Conduct]`；請勿提供超出必要範圍的個資。通報會盡可能私下處理，任何針對善意通報者的報復都不被接受。
